mapper.sql: p.id,p.notice_id AS noticeId,p.source_attachment_id AS sourceAttachmentId,p.source_type AS sourceType,p.organization_name AS organizationName,p.department_name AS departmentName,p.position_name AS positionName,p.position_code AS positionCode,p.recruit_count AS recruitCount,p.work_location AS workLocation,p.education_requirement AS educationRequirement,p.degree_requirement AS degreeRequirement,p.major_requirement AS majorRequirement,p.age_requirement AS ageRequirement,p.work_years_requirement AS workYearsRequirement,p.responsibility,p.other_requirement AS otherRequirement,p.preferred_requirement AS preferredRequirement,p.raw_requirement AS rawRequirement,p.source_sheet AS sourceSheet,p.source_row AS sourceRow,p.created_at AS createdAt,p.updated_at AS updatedAt,n.title AS noticeTitle,n.notice_url AS noticeUrl,n.publish_date AS noticePublishDate

where.if: AND p.major_requirement IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.major_requirement)!='' AND p.major_requirement NOT LIKE '%不限%' AND p.major_requirement NOT LIKE '%无要求%'

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recruitment_position WHERE notice_id=#{noticeId} AND source_type IN ('BODY_HTML','BODY_TEXT')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM recruitment_position p JOIN recruitment_notice n ON n.id=p.notice_id WHERE p.notice_id=#{noticeId} ORDER BY p.organization_name,p.source_type,p.source_sheet,p.source_row
SELECT FROM recruitment_position p JOIN recruitment_notice n ON n.id=p.notice_id WHERE p.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment_position p LEFT JOIN recruitment_match_result m ON m.position_id=p.id AND m.profile_id=#{profileId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.notice_id) FROM recruitment_position p LEFT JOIN recruitment_match_result m ON m.position_id=p.id AND m.profile_id=#{profileId}

SELECT ,m.match_result AS matchResult FROM recruitment_position p JOIN recruitment_notice n ON n.id=p.notice_id LEFT JOIN recruitment_match_result m ON m.position_id=p.id AND m.profile_id=#{profileId} ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
SELECT id FROM recruitment_position ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

SELECT DISTINCT s.source_code AS sourceCode,s.source_name AS sourceName FROM recruitment_position p JOIN recruitment_notice n ON n.id=p.notice_id JOIN recruitment_source s ON s.id=n.source_id ORDER BY s.source_name

SELECT DISTINCT n.id AS noticeId,n.title,s.source_code AS sourceCode,n.publish_date AS publishDate FROM recruitment_position p JOIN recruitment_notice n ON n.id=p.notice_id JOIN recruitment_source s ON s.id=n.source_id ORDER BY n.publish_date DESC,n.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT work_location FROM recruitment_position WHERE work_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(work_location) <> '' ORDER BY work_location
SELECT DISTINCT organization_name FROM recruitment_position WHERE organization_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(organization_name) <> '' ORDER BY organization_name
SELECT DISTINCT education_requirement FROM recruitment_position WHERE education_requirement IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(education_requirement) <> '' ORDER BY education_requirement

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN major_requirement IS NULL OR TRIM(major_requirement)='' OR major_requirement LIKE '%不限%' OR major_requirement LIKE '%专业不限%' THEN '不限专业' ELSE '有专业限制' END FROM recruitment_position ORDER BY 1

SELECT id,position_id AS positionId,requirement_type AS requirementType,requirement_level AS requirementLevel,raw_text AS rawText,normalized_value AS normalizedValue,source_text AS sourceText,created_at AS createdAt FROM recruitment_requirement WHERE position_id=#{positionId} ORDER BY id
